items.difficulty_reason: 21 行（含 11 行陈述、f_! 剪层定义）、proper 支截面构成 f_*F 的 abelian 子剪层：支集闭（Etale Cohomology 具名）+ proper-over-base 材料适用（具名 section）+ 子群（union closed 具名）+ 子预层（base change 具名）+ 层条件（支集拉回 = stalk 刻画 + stalk pullback 具名 + Descent 下降具名）。无 omit，全链具名锚定。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-f-shriek-separated (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 378-388

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the support of a section is closed so the proper-over-base material applies; the union closedness lemma makes the subset a subgroup, the base change lemma makes it a sub presheaf, and for the sheaf condition the support of a restriction is the inverse image of the support by the stalk characterization and the stalk pullback lemma, whence properness descends along the etale covering by the descending property lemma (source lines 393-414)
